schemaVersion.description: MCP I/O schema version of this input. Optional; when present it must be 1.

hashes.description: Transaction hashes to fetch and merge into ONE recording, in any order (Soroban allows one InvokeHostFunction per transaction, so a multi-step flow is several hashes). Exclusive with simulation/simulationPath.

simulation.description: A saved simulateTransaction exchange to ingest instead of fetching hashes (the shape scripts/capture-simulation.ts writes; request.params.transaction + response.result). Exclusive with hashes.

simulationPath.description: Path to a saved simulateTransaction exchange (alternative to simulation).

account.description: The account (G… or C…) token movements are attributed to. Pass it explicitly for smart-account flows; without it the first transaction’s source account is assumed and a warning records the assumption.

network.description: Stellar network. Defaults to the server configuration (POLICYWRIGHT_NETWORK, testnet).

rpcUrl.description: Soroban RPC endpoint override for this call. Defaults to the server configuration (POLICYWRIGHT_RPC_URL) or the public endpoint for the network.

outPath.description: If given, also write the recording JSON to this path (what `npm run record` would print). An existing file is not replaced unless overwrite is true.

overwrite.description: Allow outPath to replace an existing file (default false: an existing file is a BAD_INPUT).
